```lean
import CategoryTheory.Limits
import CategoryTheory.Injective
import CategoryTheory.Mono
import CategoryTheory.Epi
import CategoryTheory.Zero

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] {A B I Z : C} 
  (i : A ⟶ B) [CategoryTheory.Mono i] [CategoryTheory.Injective I] 
  (p : I ⟶ Z) (hZ : Limits.IsZero Z) : HasLiftingProperty i p := by
  let hI_proj : Projective I :=
    inferInstance
  let h_op : HasLiftingProperty p.op i.op :=
    Projective.hasLiftingProperty_of_isZero p.op i.op hI_proj (by exact Epi.of_mono (by exact Mono.of_mono i)) hZ
  exact HasLiftingProperty.iff_op i p h_op
```
